font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: var(--fig-ink, #1d2433)

g.text: Long-range contacts (|i-j| ≥ 24): Claude Fable 5.2 vs ESM-2 650M, at Fable's own number of predictions N

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: var(--fig-muted, #6b7385)

g.text: Each point is a protein. N = the long-range contacts Fable predicted for it; ESM-2 is scored on its N highest-probability long-range pairs. Point size grows with N.

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: var(--fig-muted, #6b7385)

g.text: Proteins whose reply was not scored or had no long-range contact are left out. clean: no earlier PDB relative (e < 1e-3) and sequence first public on or after 2026-07-01.

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: var(--fig-muted, #6b7385)

g.text: famous: positive control (structures long public). Grey line: equal precision.
